cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: A covering leg retraces IN FULL to its origin only when NO phase of it was validated by aligned flow. That single condition separates my two days - 0529 gave back 160 off a leg containing a genuine aligned delivery phase, 0605 gave back 1350 off a leg built entirely on absorbed selling - and it is what lets a Friday magnitude be derived as a LEVEL instead of guessed as a fraction. It is an added arm on the incumbent level.giveback_origin_shelf, not a new play.

1_adjudication_of_B_hinge_vs_withdrawal_.b_fact_check: CONCEDED, B IS RIGHT ON THE FACT. g20_mbo_evidence 20260529 phase volumes are ph1 4,715 / ph2 51,424 / ph3 60,930. ph3 IS the session's largest phase by volume, by 18 percent over ph2. B's objection that I conflated NET with PARTICIPATION is correct and the error is mine: my round-1 prose said 'nobody sold this low', 'the last 8.1 cents were traded by nobody', 'the covering bid simply went home into the weekend'. Every one of those sentences describes low participation. Participation was MAXIMAL. The word 'flowless' was accurate about the net (-59 against ph2's -1,573) and misleading about everything else I hung on it.
1_adjudication_of_B_hinge_vs_withdrawal_.b_mechanism_accepted: B's AGGRESSION HINGE is also correct as a LOCATION claim and I adopt it. Session-level signed flow across the block runs 0527 -4,910 / 0528 -1,966 / 0529 -2,126 then 0601 +3,796 / 0602 +3,524. The sign change from net-selling-into-a-held-price to net-buying-into-a-falling-price is real, and 0529 ph3's -59 sits exactly on the crossing, on the session's maximum volume. The absorber did change sides inside that phase. I had no better account of WHERE the regime turned and B does.
1_adjudication_of_B_hinge_vs_withdrawal_.b_consequence_rejected_and_the_test_that: The realized seam falsifies the version of B's consequence that matters. If ph3 were a completed transfer - a genuine change of ownership executed at maximum aggression - the -810 would be a DEFENDED level and the reopen would trade near it. It did not. 20260601 opened 3.342 against the 0529 close of 3.273: a +690 gap, recovering 85 percent of the -810 displacement before a single Monday session traded, with no publication, no catalyst and no Monday flow in between. My round-1 handoff put the seam gap prior at +570 to +690 and it realized at the top of that band. A displacement that reverts 85 percent at the first restoration of liquidity was not made by aggressors; it was made by the PASSIVE side giving way.
1_adjudication_of_B_hinge_vs_withdrawal_.resolution_both_true_on_different_ledger: These are not rival accounts of the same thing and treating them as rivals is what made the exchange look like a contradiction. B is reading the AGGRESSOR ledger, where ph3 is the crossing point. I am reading PRICE FORMATION, where ph3 is a passive-ladder failure. Both hold simultaneously and the conjunction is the actual finding: when the two aggressor sides fight to a draw at maximum volume and price still travels -810, the travel is attributable to the resting book, not to either aggressor - which is precisely why it reverts and precisely why the hinge is located there (a ladder that fails is a ladder whose owner is changing sides).
1_adjudication_of_B_hinge_vs_withdrawal_.consequence_for_my_instrument: The exit type SURVIVES with a corrected name and a MANDATORY participation condition - and the condition runs the OPPOSITE way from what B assumed I would need. Renamed PASSIVE_LADDER_DISPLACEMENT. Conditions: (a) final-phase absolute net signed flow below ~5 percent of the prior phase's (0529: 59 vs 1,573 = 3.7 percent); AND (b) final-phase volume at or above the session maximum - HIGH participation is REQUIRED, not incidental. Without (b) the type would fire on any quiet flowless close and would be a false-positive machine, which is the real substance of B's worry. With (b) it fires only on the balanced-aggression-at-maximum-volume configuration, where the reversion prior is earned.
1_adjudication_of_B_hinge_vs_withdrawal_.distribution_day_numbering: I ADOPT B's numbering. The aggressor sign change begins in 0529 ph3, so 20260601 is the first FULL distribution session, not day 2. Substantively we already agreed: my round-1 handoff told the Monday owner to watch for buy flow absorbed under a falling price as the trigger, and 0601 ph2 delivered it exactly (sflow +1,892, pxchg -2,030, ph_absorb TRUE). B's label is more precise about when the crossing began and costs nothing to accept. What I do NOT concede is dropping the gap prior, because the gap prior is the half that paid.

2_the_validated_vs_unvalidated_leg_condi.statement: A covering/absorption leg retraces to its ORIGIN in full when no phase of the leg was validated by ALIGNED flow (a phase where signed flow and price change carry the same sign, ph_absorb FALSE). A leg containing at least one aligned delivery phase is validated at that phase's level and gives back only to it. Absorbed flow buys price without validating it; aligned flow validates.
2_the_validated_vs_unvalidated_leg_condi.why_it_is_an_arm_on_an_incumbent_not_a_n: level.giveback_origin_shelf already says a terminal give-back runs toward the swing's ORIGIN shelf. What it does not say is WHEN the give-back is terminal-and-full versus mid-swing-and-partial; its own caveat flags exactly that ('distinguish mid-swing give-backs from move-terminal stretches') and leaves the distinction to judgement. The validation condition is a measurable answer to that open question, computed from the phase table the refine already has.
2_the_validated_vs_unvalidated_leg_condi.test_on_my_own_two_days_which_is_why_it_: 0529: the prior leg is 0528, which CONTAINS an aligned delivery phase (ph2 sflow +1,684 / pxchg +2,020, ph_absorb FALSE). VALIDATED -> partial give-back only. Realized -160 on a +2,090 leg = 7.7 percent. 0605: the prior leg is 0604, built entirely on absorbed selling (ph1 -164/-190 immaterial, ph2 -2,682/+1,430 absorb TRUE, ph3 -2,816/-90) with NO aligned up phase anywhere. UNVALIDATED -> full retrace to the leg origin. The 0604 leg origin is its low at 03:36, 3.240 - 0.029 = 3.211; from the 0605 open 3.355 that is -1,440, and the realized low was -1,470 (3.208), stopping within 3 ticks of the origin. Same specialist, same block, same week, opposite give-back fractions, one condition separating them.
2_the_validated_vs_unvalidated_leg_condi.consistency_check_on_a_day_i_do_not_own: 0601 is a partial pass, stated as such rather than hidden. Its up-leg's last aligned validation was 0528 ph2; 0601 fell through that level to close 3.174. The condition got the direction and the class right (unvalidated portion large -> large give-back) but the origin did not hold as a floor. Note this is the same void-condition already recorded on level.giveback_origin_shelf (the shelf BREAKS once a polarity flip is confirmed), and 0601 is where B locates the polarity inversion. Consistent, not clean. n=2 clean (both mine), 1 directional.
2_the_validated_vs_unvalidated_leg_condi.what_would_falsify_it: A leg containing a clear aligned delivery phase that nonetheless retraces past that phase's start on the next session, or a wholly-absorbed leg that stalls at 40-60 percent retrace with no fresh driver. Either kills it.

4_the_two_incumbents_that_conflict_at_th.the_conflict: The 0605 incoming handoff carries last_hour_dir -1 with last_hour_signed_flow +1 - price DOWN, flow POSITIVE. boundary.prior_close_flow_direction_disagreement reads that configuration as 'covering or buy-absorption building -> next session biased to a reversal/rally continuation of the FLOW side', i.e. UP. structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell case (b) reads the identical configuration as 'BUY flow ABSORBED under a falling price = buy-absorption FAILING -> stays DOWN'. Two live incumbents, one boundary state, opposite signs. Read literally, the first one flips my 0605 to UP and loses 1,350.
4_the_two_incumbents_that_conflict_at_th.what_selects: structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip, and its own text is explicit: 'Maximally extended (cum high ~>+2000 vs block anchor AND age >=5) with the absorption tell ITSELF reversed (aligned-down delivery, or big BUY absorbed under falling price): the identical signature = late chasers absorbed = DISTRIBUTION DOWN.' The incoming cum_from_anchor is +3,200 - the block extreme - and the reversed tell is present in the last hour. The flip fires, the disagreement play's default is overridden, and DOWN survives. General statement: boundary.prior_close_flow_direction_disagreement is EXTENSION-GATED and should say so; at low extension it points to the flow side, at maximal extension with the tell reversed it points against it.
4_the_two_incumbents_that_conflict_at_th.a_defect_in_the_gate_i_have_to_report: The extension gate's second arm is 'age >=5'. The handoff hands me chain_age_sessions = 2, because a single -70 close on 0602 reset the close-alternation label. The covering REGIME is seven sessions old (0527 through 0604, six of seven absorb_session TRUE). Read off the label the gate does NOT fire and the conflict resolves the wrong way by 1,350. Per boundary.chain_label_must_track_realized_cum the label is supposed to track realized cum, and cum ran +2,550 -> +3,200 straight through 0602 without ever turning. The age arm must read the REGIME age - sessions since cum_from_anchor last turned - not the close-alternation count, or a trivial 70-dollar down day disarms the block's most important gate. This is a general defect, it is decidable at the open, and it costs the block's largest single day if unfixed.
